verses.text: This is the record of Adam's family line. When God created humankind, he made them to reflect God.
He created them male and female, blessed them, and named them Humankind on the day they were created.
Adam was 130 years old when he had a son who looked like him and reflected his image. He named him Seth.
After Seth was born, Adam lived another 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
Adam lived 930 years in all, then he died.
Seth was 105 years old when he had Enosh.
After Enosh was born, Seth lived another 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
Seth lived 912 years in all, then he died.
Enosh was 90 years old when he had Kenan.
After Kenan was born, Enosh lived another 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
Enosh lived 905 years in all, then he died.
Kenan was 70 years old when he had Mahalalel.
After Mahalalel was born, Kenan lived another 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
Kenan lived 910 years in all, then he died.
Mahalalel was 65 years old when he had Jared.
After Jared was born, Mahalalel lived another 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
Mahalalel lived 895 years in all, then he died.
Jared was 162 years old when he had Enoch.
After Enoch was born, Jared lived another 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
Jared lived 962 years in all, then he died.
Enoch was 65 years old when he had Methuselah.
After Methuselah was born, Enoch walked with God for another 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
Enoch lived 365 years in all.
Enoch walked with God, and then he was gone, because God took him.
Methuselah was 187 years old when he had Lamech.
After Lamech was born, Methuselah lived another 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
Methuselah lived 969 years in all, then he died.
Lamech was 182 years old when he had a son.
He named him Noah, saying, "This one will bring us relief from our work and the hard labor of our hands caused by the ground Yahweh cursed."
After Noah was born, Lamech lived another 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
Lamech lived 777 years in all, then he died.
When Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
